item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Lalit looks at the figure: line AOB is straight through O, and ray OC meets AOB so that angle $1$ equals angle $2$.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Angle $1$ is a right angle for any split of AOB, even when angle $1$ is not half of the straight angle.
options.B: He should first study the decorative history of the diagram before classifying any angle.
options.C: AOB is a straight angle (a half turn); because angle $1$ equals angle $2$, each is a right angle, so OC is perpendicular to AOB.
options.D: The answer is "straight angle", because those words are printed beside AOB, without using the equal split.
